description: Asks, on a writable copy, how COUNTER and AUTOINCREMENT and IDENTITY accept a seed and increment through Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) and what they generate: seeds 0, 1, 10, 100, negative, 2147483647 and fractional, increments 1, 5, 0 and -1, a single-argument form, two counters in one table. Each table Cs<i> is created, two rows are inserted without the counter, a row with the counter set to 50, then one more without it, and the rows are read ordered by the counter; DBEngine.Errors follows each statement that may fail. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

SELECT * FROM Cs0 ORDER BY B
CREATE TABLE Cs1 (A COUNTER(100, 5), B LONG)
SELECT * FROM Cs1 ORDER BY B

SELECT * FROM Cs2 ORDER BY B
